product_updates.title: America.gov gets really weird when you ask it about Minecraft, but it’s not a glitch
product_updates.content: For the sake of national security, it's a relief to learn that America.gov is not hallucinating to the point that it's penning lengthy poetry.

product_updates.title: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
product_updates.content: Before OpenAI launched its new AI agent, Dots, on Tuesday, Elon Musk's xAI had already acquired the domain name "dot.com," which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page.

product_updates.title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model
product_updates.content: OpenAI is building out the pieces of an alternative to the traditional app store model, turning ChatGPT into a place where software can be discovered and used by people and AI agents alike.

product_updates.title: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
product_updates.content: The new round is anticipated to be the company's last before its delayed 2027 public debut.

product_updates.title: Here’s why OpenAI is absent from Nvidia’s industry-wide effort to end rogue AI agents
product_updates.content: OpenAI isn't a public supporter of Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, but it is privately working with Nvidia, TechCrunch has learned.

product_updates.title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with the launch of what feels a whole lot like ChatGPT’s own office suite
product_updates.content: OpenAI's newly announced suite of office features puts it into more direct competition with more traditional software companies.

product_updates.title: AI-powered app maker Wabi pivots to a messaging experience
product_updates.content: Wabi is repositioning its prompt-based app builder as a personal AI agent that can create interfaces on demand, combining chat, apps, and ongoing tasks.

product_updates.title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
product_updates.content: Dots are meant to operate independent of any specific hardware or interface, pursuing user-defined goals continuously in the background with minimal oversight.

product_updates.title: OpenAI gives Codex reusable cloud environments that work across devices
product_updates.content: OpenAI is expanding Codex with reusable cloud development environments, a revamped CLI with voice controls, new code review tools, and a security-focused product for scanning repositories and preparing fixes.

product_updates.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plug-ins with app-like interfaces and automations
product_updates.content: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT plug-ins with dedicated sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, improved discovery, and support for automations.
